It traced the shared Distrib path between two projects and proposed reasonable fixes. However, it missed a critical piece of the root cause (CAS read-only hard links), didn't fully investigate all three projects sharing the path (missed Common), and didn't verify its conclusions. The 42 tool calls in 205 seconds show methodical work, but some searches were redundant. The investigation is competent but incomplete on the deeper 'why' question.
